Question 6
?

Which of the following parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), generate a circle of radius 1 centered at the point (3,2)?

a
x=cos⁡θ+3,y=sin⁡θ+2
b
x=cos⁡θ−3,y=sin⁡θ−2
c
 x=3cos⁡θ+1,y=2sin⁡θ+1
d
 x=cos⁡θ−2,y=sin⁡θ−3
e
 x=cos⁡θ+2,y=sin⁡θ+3
